articles.summary: We’re excited to share how we're making "podman pull" ten times faster by lazily fetching container images using the SOCI Snapshotter.
articles.title: Lazily Pulling Container Images with Podman and SOCI Snapshotter

articles.summary: Another year, another Bazelcon! This year's edition was held in Munich, Germany, and featured two days of talks by Bazel maintainers, contributers, and users. Among the Bazel users represented as this year's conference were: Booking.com, RabbitMQ, Spotify, Stripe, Uber, and more.
articles.title: Bazelcon 2023 Recap
